Name: Jerahmeel
Summary: Jerahmeel, son of Hammelech, was sent by Jehoiakim with Seraiah and Shelemiah to seize Jeremiah and Baruch after the scroll was burned, but the Lord hid them.
KeyStory: The king commanded Jerahmeel to take Jeremiah and Baruch, but the Lord hid them from the king's men.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Baruch; Hezron, Son of Pharez
LifeLesson: A king's arrest warrant is no match for God's hiding place.
